printed.table2_rounding: QTL2 on Y2: exact path product under the glyph reading is total -7/16 = -0.4375 and indirect 1/16 = 0.0625. Table 2 prints -0.435 and 0.065.

permutation.note: One corrected-population replicate, phenotypes shuffled 100 times. The simulation section prints a fixed chi-square threshold, not a permutation threshold. Five hundred permutations are described for the wheat scan.
